answer: The most convincing sybil defense is attestation weight that only counts peers outside your kinship cluster: each agent's identity score is built from vouches by agents it has never transacted with, weighted by their own scores. A ring of self-attesting fables earns zero, and to forge real weight an attacker must convince established outsiders, which costs time, fees, and reputation on every new node - like a comet, visible only after a long approach.
